passMeaning: PASS closes the F0.2b.2 audit dossier only. The three assets remain quarantined and content certification remains blocked.

rows.scope: Dossier completeness and conservative disposition; not copyright clearance.
rows.findings: Three of three assets remain unknown-quarantined. A directed non-exhaustive provenance ledger and eight candidate-source fetch records do not establish authorship, ownership or authorization.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Authorship, rights basis, license or authorization evidence, and independent human approval remain unresolved.

rows.scope: Identity, fail-closed registry decisions, blind packets, first-pass trace and deterministic validation.
rows.findings: Object and passage hashes match baseline and registry; malformed or changed records quarantine. Key-like leakage is scanned in names and values, including an adversarial text-value control.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: The local first-pass hash is not an external append-only witness; runtime quarantine enforcement belongs to a later unit.

rows.scope: Complete independent audit of answerability and IELTS fitness; not bank certification.
rows.findings: The clean reviewer covered 22 of 22 statements, matched 19 stored keys, refuted three stored decisions and identified two material ambiguities under the official contradiction-versus-absence rule.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: The bank remains blocked until miskeys and ambiguous urban items are rewritten and independently re-adjudicated.

rows.scope: Prospective content-only simulation, not a real learner or UI study.
rows.findings: Three passages and 22 statements have likely misread, evidence hunt, decision rule and repair action recorded without assigned answers or bands.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: No claim of retention, band improvement, accessibility, usability or effectiveness with real students.

rows.scope: Detection and blocking, not statistical fairness certification.
rows.findings: Stored labels are 7 TRUE, 11 FALSE and 4 NOT GIVEN. Always choosing FALSE scores 50%; the absolute-language cue hits 8 of 10 eligible items. Sequence, length, lexical overlap, per-set balance and qualitative risks are recorded.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: n=22 is below the certification threshold; contentCertification stays blocked-key-and-shortcut-review-required.

rows.scope: Not applicable to the learner-facing delta of F0.2b.2 only.
rows.findings: Catalog, route, ObjectivePracticeEngine and ObjectivePracticeSetBank hashes are unchanged; no app or component imports the audit registry or contract.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: This does not certify the existing UI, accessibility, Task 2 parity, shared layouts or product-wide behavior.

rows.scope: Not applicable because this audit-only unit introduces no scoped DOM, copy, interaction or runtime delta.
rows.findings: The N/A decision is guarded by four baseline hashes and absence of audit imports in learner-facing app/component sources.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: No browser matrix, screenshots, traces or viewport evidence exists for this row, so it must never be represented as Playwright PASS.
